description: Consumption of Other Fuels, Borough is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. Estimates of consumption of non gas, non electricity and non road transport fuels. (1) Includes consumption within industry and the energy sectors including oil refineries. (2) Excludes the consumption of propane. (3) Includes some coal consumption by auto-generators. (4) Excludes renewables and wastes used for electricity generation. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
